title: Condensed realization of the integral stage
statement: The original condensed_stage declarations of integral counit realization, with their unchanged hypotheses and conclusions: for every supplied integral model m and Stage A, there is a CondensedStage for A, using the normalized encoding equivalences and the same fixed counit.

source.place: Purity transport Steps 1--4; relocation of the existing condensed_stage declarations

proof.text: The normalized integral/condensed equivalences and the actual compact-support and twisted-pullback endpoint comparisons are supplied by lem-pur-condensed-integral-endpoints. Compose the inverse X equivalence adjunction, integral_stage adjunction, and Y equivalence adjunction; transport along these endpoint isomorphisms. The equivalence-adjunction comparison gives the unit and counit equations. Counit-preserving uniqueness gives fixed_counit. This is the Lean proof of condensed_stage.
